official: 東久留米市職員の給与に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 付議案件
令和8年第1回定例会 会議結果

name: 市職員の給料と手当を改定
summary: 市職員の給料や手当は、条例の給料表や支給条件で定めています。この議案では給料表を改め、扶養手当や通勤手当などの支給内容を変更します。令和8年4月1日から施行し、地域手当の割合は当分の間14%とします。
changes: 給料表を改め、地域手当の割合を当分の間14%とする
子の扶養手当を月11,500円から13,000円にし、配偶者を扶養手当の対象から外す
駐車場料金への通勤手当を月5,000円まで設け、自転車等の距離別支給額を改める
災害対応手当を1回3,000円とする
why: 人事院勧告や東京都人事委員会勧告などに伴い、職員の給与や手当を改定する必要があるためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Revises salaries and allowances for Higashikurume City employees
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Higashikurume City Ordinance on Salaries of City Employees
en.summary: The salaries and allowances of city employees are set out in salary tables and payment conditions in ordinances. This bill revises the salary table and changes the payment details for dependent allowances, commuting allowances and other allowances. It will take effect on April 1, 2026, and the regional allowance rate will be 14% for the time being.
changes: Revises the salary table and sets the regional allowance rate at 14% for the time being
Raises the monthly dependent allowance for children from ¥11,500 to ¥13,000 and removes spouses from eligibility for the dependent allowance
Introduces a commuting allowance for parking fees of up to ¥5,000 per month and revises distance-based payment amounts for bicycles and other forms of transport
Sets the disaster response allowance at ¥3,000 per occurrence
en.why: The city says it needs to revise employee salaries and allowances in response to recommendations from the National Personnel Authority and the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Personnel Commission, among others.
